{{Quote|Then there are the ''seers'' -- Je'daii who perceive the Force in dreams and visions, sharing their images and impressions for us to interpret, in order to divine where the enemy will strike next.|Daegen Lok|<ref name="DOTJ:FW1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force War 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force War'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Je'daii seer''' was a term which referred to a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] who perceive [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] in [[Force vision/Legends|dreams and visions]].

{{Stub}}

==Overview==
A rank within the [[Je'daii Order]], seers were members who were responsible for receiving [[Force vision/Legends|Force visions]] and sharing them with other [[Je'daii]] to interpret.<ref name="DOTJ:FW1" />
